name: Legal-Sector and Accountant Gatekeeper Misuse
description: Misuse of lawyers, notaries, accountants and similar professionals, witting or unwitting, to create structures, hold or move client funds, buy assets or lend credibility to transactions. Client accounts and professional privilege are used to distance funds from their source.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Vulnerabilities of Legal Professionals (2013)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach for Legal Professionals (2019)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach for the Accounting Profession (2019)

exposure.rationale: Lawyers, notaries and accountants run client accounts, form structures and buy assets for clients; fees or deposits sometimes in cash.

indicators.name: Client account used with no underlying legal work
indicators.canon: Professional client account used as pass-through
indicators.desc: A professional's client account is used to move funds with no underlying legal or advisory work.
indicators.ctx: Funds pass through client account without a legal service.

indicators.name: Instructions to transfer funds to third parties without explanation
indicators.canon: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.desc: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.
indicators.ctx: Sudden redirection of funds to unrelated beneficiaries.

indicators.name: Complex structures with no commercial reason
indicators.canon: Complex layered structure without commercial rationale
indicators.desc: Multiple tiers of entities, trusts or foundations, often across secrecy or low-transparency jurisdictions, with no evident business or tax reason.
indicators.ctx: Creation of layered entities and trusts.

indicators.name: Aborted transactions with funds returned elsewhere
indicators.canon: Aborted transactions with funds returned elsewhere
indicators.desc: Deals cancelled and money sent to different parties.
indicators.ctx: Deals cancelled and money sent to different parties.

indicators.name: Client insists on speed or secrecy
indicators.canon: Pressure to speed up or bypass checks
indicators.desc: Customer or intermediary urges rapid completion, secrecy or bypassing of checks, or leans on personal connections.

indicators.name: Client unwilling to provide ownership or source of funds
indicators.canon: Client unwilling to provide ownership or source of funds
indicators.desc: Refuses details of beneficial owner or source.
indicators.ctx: Refuses details of beneficial owner or source.

indicators.name: Professional's role unusual for the work
indicators.canon: Professional's role unusual for the work
indicators.desc: Professional acts as nominee, director, or intermediary beyond normal remit.
indicators.ctx: Professional acts as nominee, director, or intermediary beyond normal remit.

indicators.name: Customer geography far from the professional's practice
indicators.canon: Customer geography far from the professional's practice
indicators.desc: No reason to use this adviser.
indicators.ctx: No reason to use this adviser.
